<thought>To design a three‑step retrosynthetic route, I will disconnect the target molecule as follows:
1. Break the amide bond (C(=O)‑N) to give an α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid and an aniline (retro‑amide formation).
2. Apply the Doebner modification in reverse: disconnect the α,β‑unsaturated acid into the corresponding aromatic aldehyde (bearing the sulfonyl group) and malonic acid (retro‑Doebner).
3. Disconnect the sulfonamide N‑S bond to give p‑toluidine and the aryl‑sulfonyl chloride (retro‑sulfonamide formation).

I will now search for suitable retrosynthetic templates for each of these disconnections.
